Likhanāvalī
Skt. on letter writing. by Vidyāpati Upādhyāya of Mithilā an. attributed by the a. to King Purāditya his patron, mentioned by the a. himself on. p. 27, of the work. See J. of Dept. of Letters, Cal. Uni. XVI. p.. 23-54; also in JASB (NS). XI (1915) 391.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. sn. 403.

Likhitarudra
lexicographer an. also a grammarian, q. by Rāyamukuṭa in his C. on [Page244-b]Amarakośa,

Likhitasmṛti
dh. by Likhita Ṛṣi, son of Kaṇva. mentioned by Yājñavalkya an. others. C.. Śaṅkhalikhita.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1098b.
